claims.text: Rosewood Doha is in Lusail, Qatar.

findings.quote: Rosewood DohaLusail, Qatar

claims.text: The hotel stands on the south-easterly tip of Lusail's Marina District.

findings.quote: A 30-minute drive from Hamad International Airport delivers us to Lusail, dubbed Qatar’s Future City. On the south-easterly tip of its Marina District, the two towers of Rosewood Doha emerge

claims.text: The reception area displays pieces sourced from Souq Waqif, including brass-studded wooden boxes traditionally used to store a dowry.

findings.quote: The reception area features immediate nods to Qatari culture, many sourced from the winding alleys of Doha’s famed Souq Waqif, including brass-studded wooden boxes traditionally used to store a woman’s dowry

claims.text: Artworks by local creatives such as Yasser Al Mulla and Azzam Al Mannai hang on the walls.

findings.quote: artworks by local creatives such as Yasser Al Mulla and Azzam Al Mannai adorn walls

claims.text: The hotel has eight dining spaces.

findings.quote: Fire and spice shape eight dining spaces

claims.text: Koo Madame's dining space is designed to evoke 1920s Shanghai.

findings.quote: I have an exceptional Chinese meal at Koo Madame
served in a space that transports guests to 1920s Shanghai

claims.text: Mila serves Levantine recipes on Doha's Arabian Gulf shoreline.

findings.quote: Where time-honored Levantine recipes meet modern flair, Mila brings refined flavor and vibrancy to Doha’s Arabian Gulf shoreline.

claims.text: Stoke & Stoker pairs cocktails with Asian plates and crudo, overlooking the Gulf.

findings.quote: Where adventurous spirits meet refined mixology, paired with Asian plates and crudo, overlooking the Gulf.

claims.text: Asaya Kitchen works with local farmers, purveyors and artisans.

findings.quote: Asaya Kitchen celebrates provenance through the work of local farmers, purveyors, and artisans.

claims.text: Junior Suites have Arabian Gulf or Lusail City views and a marble bathroom with a double rain shower.

findings.quote: Junior Suites feature Arabian Gulf or Lusail City views, a seating area, and a marble bathroom with a double rain shower

claims.text: The Reef Suite has a king bedroom, a marble bath, living and dining spaces, and butler service.

findings.quote: the Reef Suite blends modern design with Qatari creativity, offering a king bedroom, marble bath, living and dining spaces, and butler service.

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler named Rosewood Doha to its Hot List 2026.

findings.quote: Hot List 2026

claims.text: The two towers are encased in a white latticed facade inspired by the forms of a coral reef.

findings.quote: the two towers of Rosewood Doha emerge, seemingly from the sea, encased in a striking white latticed facade inspired by the forms of a coral reef

claims.text: Guests can take pottery classes with local architect and ceramicist Reema Abu Hassan at Clay Encounters.

findings.quote: pottery classes with local architect and ceramicist Reema Abu Hassan at the charming, sun-filled, sea-facing Clay Encounters

claims.text: The hotel offers a leisurely lunch aboard a traditional dhow through Lusail's waterways, and an encounter with Qatar's art of falconry.

findings.quote: Savor a leisurely lunch aboard a traditional dhow, drifting through Lusail’s serene waterways.
An encounter with Qatar’s revered art of falconry

claims.text: Afternoon tea at The Butterfly Room is bookended with a dedicated chocolate trolley.

findings.quote: But I find myself returning time and again to the Butterfly Room
a decadent afternoon tea bookended with a dedicated chocolate trolley

claims.text: Children are catered to through the Rosewood Explorers programme, with a dedicated kids pool, an outdoor play area and an indoor kids club.

findings.quote: Little ones are well catered to via the Rosewood Explorers programme. There’s a dedicated kids pool, outdoor play area and an indoor kids club

claims.text: The hotel is in Lusail, which is a 30-minute drive from Hamad International Airport.

findings.quote: A 30-minute drive from Hamad International Airport delivers us to Lusail

claims.text: WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the ultra-luxury positioning.
